test: Optional native_player Debian package in Armbian private vendor input and target rootfs customization

rejected_inputs: amd64 executable in an arm64-labelled package

rootfs_test.source: read-only rootfs from t736-armbian-source-v10.raw.img (Trixie GNOME arm64); all writes confined to a temporary overlay
rootfs_test.method: Network-isolated build-host chroot using AArch64 binfmt; actual apt-get local installs; native player package verification through target dpkg-query, dpkg -V and ffplay -version
rootfs_test.full_hook: Generated userpatches/t736-private/tools/t736-customize-image.sh succeeded. Desktop packages were already present, and password reset was disabled for this run. Verified PVR vermagic/module index against an actual media-v29 module tree.

scope: Private rootfs package integration only. Default kernel/boot selection was not changed. No image flash or end-to-end new-image boot performed.

upgrade_0_1_2.method: A separate pinned official checkout generated the private vendor input and customization hook. A network-isolated AArch64 chroot on a writable overlay of the read-only Trixie GNOME image installed 0.1-1, then ran that hook with local packages and the media-v29 kernel module tree. Existing desktop packages and credentials were retained.
